snippet.title: HeroQuest: Digital Edition | Official Announce Trailer | Balor Games
snippet.description:
The quest is calling... https://playheroquest.com 

Descend into the dungeon to destroy the forces of Dread and protect the Realm in HeroQuest: Digital Edition, a tactical turn-based RPG based on the timeless tabletop legacy. 

Form a fellowship of four or set forth on your adventure solo. Roll the dice, and let the quest begin!

Developed by: https://www.youtube.com/@NomadGamesOfficial
